tasks.description: Migrate EXPM1 unary operation: compute exp(x)-1 with numerical stability
steps: Add op_expm1 functor to element_wise.cpp following existing pattern (op_elu already uses sycl::expm1 internally)
Add ggml_sycl_expm1 wrapper function following existing unary op pattern

Added op_expm1 functor, ggml_sycl_op_expm1 wrapper, and ggml_sycl_expm1 public function to element_wise.cpp. Declared in element_wise.hpp. Added dispatch in ggml-sycl.cpp. Placed EXPM1 in the FLOOR/CEIL/ROUND/TRUNC supports_op group (with F32-only check when GGML_SYCL_F16 is off) to avoid assertion failure on F16 inputs. 2/2 unit tests pass on Intel BMG GPU.

Fixed CUDA implicit bool-to-float conversion to explicit ternary. 1/1 unit test passes on Intel BMG GPU.

steps: Create ggml/src/ggml-sycl/opt-step-adamw.hpp with declaration for ggml_sycl_op_opt_step_adamw
Create ggml/src/ggml-sycl/opt-step-adamw.cpp: element-wise AdamW update (m, v momentum updates, weight decay, bias correction)
Read op params: lr, beta1, beta2, eps, weight_decay from ggml_tensor op_params
tasks.notes: Completed. Created opt-step-adamw.hpp and opt-step-adamw.cpp with SYCL kernel for element-wise AdamW update: m = m*beta1 + g*(1-beta1), v = v*beta2 + g*g*(1-beta2), x = x*(1-alpha*wd) - alpha*(m*beta1h)/(sqrt(v*beta2h)+eps). F32-only. 5 input tensors (x, grad, m, v, params with 7 floats). Registered dispatch and supports_op in ggml-sycl.cpp. CMakeLists auto-globs so no change needed. 1/1 unit test passes on Intel BMG GPU.

tasks.description: Migrate flash attention kernels (MMA, tile, vec, WMMA variants)
steps: - Create fattn-common.hpp with SYCL equivalents of helper functions
Phase 2 - Vec kernel (simplest, highest value for single-query):
- Migrate flash_attn_ext_vec (ck_057): vectorized attention for batch=1
- Replace warp shuffles with sycl::sub_group operations
- Handle 42 template instances for type combinations
- Migrate flash_attn_tile (ck_056): tiled attention without tensor cores
Phase 4 - MMA/WMMA kernels (most complex, optional for initial support):
- Migrate flash_attn_ext_f16 MMA (ck_055): requires PTX inline asm replacement
- Migrate flash_attn_ext_f16 WMMA (ck_058): uses nvcuda::wmma -> sycl joint_matrix
- Replace cp.async with SYCL async copy or prefetch
Create dispatch function in fattn.cpp selecting between available implementations
tasks.notes: HIGHEST IMPACT task for inference performance. 7 kernels, 152+ template instances in CUDA. Start with vec kernel (most common in inference). MMA/WMMA kernels use NVIDIA-specific tensor core intrinsics that need Intel XMX (joint_matrix) equivalents. cp.async has no direct SYCL equivalent; use prefetch or explicit staging. This should be decomposed into sub-tasks during implementation.
